scene tonotascend1
I decide to spend the night over at Tojo Ramen and, as is oftentimes customary, Yuki is here as well.
lines.zh: 我决定今晚在 Tojo Ramen 过，而按惯例，Yuki 也在这儿。

lines.en: Business has picked back up following the green onion incident and, believe it or not, the Produce Delivery Administration (Confirmed real) never caught onto Tsuneyo’s negligence in...ordering produce.
lines.zh: 葱事件之后生意又回来了，而且信不信由你，农产品配送管理局（已确认是真的）始终没发现 Tsuneyo 在……订购农产品上的疏忽。

lines.en: I don’t know. Operating a restaurant sounds like a lot of work.
lines.zh: 我说不上来。经营餐馆听起来挺累的。

lines.en: I’m glad things are back to normal, though...whatever “normal” means for Tsuneyo and her weird, Yakuza hideout ramen shop thing.
lines.zh: 不过我很高兴一切恢复正常了……无论对 Tsuneyo 和她那间诡异的、山口组据点般的拉面店来说，「正常」是什么意思。

lines.en: : Welcome to Tojo Ramen. Please take your time looking over the menu.
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。请慢慢看菜单。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, I’ve been here for almost an hour now. I’ve already eaten.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，我都来快一个小时了。我已经吃完了。

lines.en: : I know. I was trying to make conversation, but defaulted to a standard greeting without thinking.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我是想跟你聊聊天，结果下意识就用了标准问候语。

lines.en: : Give the girl a break, man. She’s just tryin’ to talk to you.
lines.zh: : 放过这姑娘吧，哥们。她只是想跟你说说话。

lines.en: scene tonotascend2
: I said one thing.
lines.zh: : 我就说了一句。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’ve been just sittin’ there mindin’ your own business the entire night. It’s makin’ shit real awkward.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你整晚就坐那儿忙自己的。搞得气氛贼尴尬。

lines.en: : One hour can’t really be considered “the entire night.”
lines.zh: : 一个小时也算不上「整晚」吧。

lines.en: : Perhaps the three of us should play some sort of game.
lines.zh: : 也许我们三个该玩点什么游戏。

lines.en: : Or, one of you two can open up about your secrets to me and I can stand silently behind this counter and nod.
lines.zh: : 或者，你们两个谁把秘密告诉我，我就站在这柜台后面默默点头。

lines.en: scene tonotascend3
: You’ve basically heard everything I’ve got to say already.
lines.zh: : 我想说的话你基本都听过了。

lines.en: : Hell, I’d be surprised if you and your pops couldn’t recite my life story by now.
lines.zh: : 操，要是你和你老爹现在还背不出我的人生故事，我反倒要吃惊了。

lines.en: : Surely, there must be another secret.
lines.zh: : 一定还有别的秘密吧。

lines.en: : There isn't. And don't call me Shirley.
lines.zh: : 没有。还有别叫我 Shirley。

lines.en: : That doesn't really work in text form.
lines.zh: : 这梗在文字里不成立。

lines.en: : Life passes by so quickly. Things happen.
lines.zh: : 人生过得真快。事情一件接一件。

lines.en: : What sort of things have happened to you recently?
lines.zh: : 你最近发生了些什么事？

lines.en: scene tonotascend4
: Uhh...things...things...
: Oh. I think I got hit on at work the other day?
lines.zh: : 哦。我想起来前几天上班被人搭讪了？

lines.en: : Who was it that attacked you?
lines.zh: : 是谁袭击了你？

lines.en: : Hitting “on” someone is different than just hitting them, Tsuneyo. It means flirting.
lines.zh: : 「搭讪」和「打」不一样，Tsuneyo。搭讪是调情的意思。

lines.en: : Who was it that attacked you {i}with love{/i}?
lines.zh: : 是谁{i}用爱{/i}袭击了你？

lines.en: scene tonotascend5
: Uhh...I don’t know. Some older bitch who was drunk off her ass?
lines.zh: : 呃……不知道。某个喝得烂醉的老女人吧？

lines.en: : And when {i}I{/i} say somebody’s older, that means they’re fuckin’ {i}old{/i}.
lines.zh: : 而且{i}我{/i}说的「老」，那是真的他妈的{i}老{/i}。

lines.en: : Nonsense. You are full of life despite nearly forty years of addiction to nicotine and narcotics.
lines.zh: : 胡说。尽管尼古丁和毒品上了近四十年的瘾，你依然充满活力。

lines.en: scene tonotascend6
: Thanks, Tsu-chan. Always appreciate you pointin’ that shit out.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Tsu-chan。总是劳驾你指出这些破事。

lines.en: : I have a hard time believing you were addicted to those things starting at birth. It can’t be “nearly forty years” if you’re still under forty.
lines.zh: : 我很难相信你从出生起就对这些东西上瘾。你还不到四十，就不可能是「近四十年」。

lines.en: : Besides, I don’t even think you look {i}that{/i} old.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我觉得你看起来也没{i}那么{/i}老。

lines.en: : Be careful, Yuki. I believe this man is attempting to hit you.
lines.zh: : 小心点，Yuki。我觉得这个男人在试图打你。

lines.en: scene tonotascend7
: You don’t have to worry about this guy, Tsu-chan. If he was actually tryin’ to hit me, his arms and legs would already be submerged in one of those big ass pots you’ve got behind the counter.
lines.zh: : 你不用担心这家伙，Tsu-chan。他要是真想打我，胳膊腿早就泡在你柜台后面那些大锅里了。

lines.en: : He does not look appetizing. Do not taint my broth in this fashion.
lines.zh: : 他看起来不好吃。别用这种方式污染我的汤底。

lines.en: : Again, hitting {i}on{/i} someone and hitting them are two completely different things.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，「{i}搭讪{/i}」和「打」是完全不同的两件事。

lines.en: : So you were hitting {i}on{/i} her?
lines.zh: : 所以你是在{i}搭讪{/i}她？

lines.en: : Not intentionally, but probably. That’s a thing I tend to do quite often.
lines.zh: : 不是有意的，但大概是。这种事我经常干。

lines.en: : Beats me as to why. I’m not only older than you, but {i}well{/i} past my days of bein’ cute and lovable.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道为什么。我不仅比你大，而且{i}早就{/i}过了可爱讨喜的年纪。

lines.en: : Go after somebody younger and prettier. Like Tsu-chan or Yumi.
lines.zh: : 去找更年轻更漂亮的吧。比如 Tsu-chan 或者 Yumi。

lines.en: : Not it.
lines.zh: : 别找我。

lines.en: : Thank you for not only naming two of the girls who appear to have negative interest in me, but including your daughter among them.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你不仅点名了两个似乎对我毫无兴趣的女孩，还把你女儿也算了进去。

lines.en: : Hey, maybe she’ll lighten up once she gets laid and actually consider talkin’ to me again.
lines.zh: : 嘿，也许等她破了处就会放轻松，真的考虑再跟我说话了。

lines.en: : Just wrap it up first and it’ll be like nothin’ even happened.
lines.zh: : 先把这事办了，然后就当什么都没发生过。

lines.en: : There is nothing to wrap. He has already finished his meal.
lines.zh: : 没有什么可办的。他已经吃完了。

lines.en: scene tonotascend8
: Tsuneyo, why did your father decide it was okay for you to leave the nest if you can’t pick up on...{i}any{/i} context clues in conversation?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，既然你在对话里{i}一点{/i}语境线索都抓不到，你父亲为什么还觉得你可以离巢？

lines.en: : Because I have grown as much as I can in this one place.
lines.zh: : 因为我在这个地方已经成长到了极限。

lines.en: : In order to become a better person, I must greet the world with open arms and a fistful of noodles.
lines.zh: : 为了成为更好的人，我必须张开双臂、抓着一把面条去迎接这个世界。

lines.en: : I must spread the word of Tojo Ramen so that it will not be forgotten.
lines.zh: : 我必须传播 Tojo Ramen 的名声，好让它不被遗忘。

lines.en: : And if I happen to learn things along the way, I can show my father that it was not the wrong choice to allow me this freedom.
lines.zh: : 如果我沿途能学到点什么，我就能向父亲证明，给我这份自由并不是错误的选择。

lines.en: scene tonotascend9
: Hah...that guy’s always been a fuckin’ weird one.
lines.zh: : 哈……那家伙一直是个他妈的怪人。

lines.en: : Watch your tongue. I know where the cutlery is and sharpened it myself earlier today.
lines.zh: : 管好你的嘴。我知道餐具在哪儿，而且今天早些时候我亲手把它们磨快了。

lines.en: : I just mean that {i}I{/i} think he should’a let you out into the real world a long fuckin’ time ago.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}只是觉得，他早该他妈的放你出去见见真实世界了。

lines.en: : Bein’ cooped up in here can only do so much for ya, you know?
lines.zh: : 一直被关在这儿对你也没多大好处，你懂吧？

lines.en: scene tonotascend10
: Look at Yumi. She’s been goin’ out and doin’ shit on her own for years now...And she runs an independent business.
lines.zh: : 看看 Yumi。她自己出去闯荡好多年了……而且还经营着一门独立的生意。

lines.en: : That could be you, Tsu-chan.
lines.zh: : 你也可以这样，Tsu-chan。

lines.en: : Okay, sure. But Yumi’s business is selling stolen TVs and Tsuneyo’s business is...an actual business.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。可 Yumi 的生意是卖偷来的电视，而 Tsuneyo 的生意是……正经生意。

lines.en: : Tomato tomato.
lines.zh: : 半斤八两。

lines.en: : That doesn't work in text form either. Stop doing that.
lines.zh: : 这在文字里也不成立。别再这么干了。

lines.en: : Alls I’m sayin’ is that your pops might not’ve {i}always{/i} known what’s best for ya, you know?
lines.zh: : 我要说的是，你爸可能也不{i}总是{/i}知道什么对你最好，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Fucker still owes me like five grand from mahjong.
lines.zh: : 那混蛋打麻将还欠我大概五千块。

lines.en: scene tonotascend11
: So it was true after all...
lines.zh: : 原来是真的……

lines.en: : It appears that I will have to sell my body to Yuki to make up for the debt.
lines.zh: : 看来我得把自己卖给 Yuki，才能还清这笔债了。

lines.en: scene tonotascend12
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : You know I don’t swing that way, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我不搞那方面的，对吧？

lines.en: : Just fuckin’ pay me back in free food. I don’t need your body.
lines.zh: : 用免费的食物还我就行。我不要你的身体。

lines.en: : I’ll take it.
lines.zh: : 我要。

lines.en: : You need to leave the knives behind, though. They’d make me uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 不过你得把刀留下。它们会让我不自在。

lines.en: : As long as I can bring my noodles, I will be fine.
lines.zh: : 只要能带上面条，我就没事。

lines.en: : ...Which one? Because I’m not particularly fond of either option, but one of them would make me significantly more uncomfortable than the other.
lines.zh: : ……哪个？两个选项我都不太喜欢，但其中一个会让我比另一个不自在得多。

lines.en: scene black
: JESUS fuck! The hell was that?!
lines.zh: : 我操！那他妈是什么？！

lines.en: : Ah. It appears there has been another power failure.
lines.zh: : 啊。看来又停电了。

lines.en: : The backup generator should switch on shortly.
lines.zh: : 备用发电机应该很快就会启动。

lines.en: I take a moment to calm myself after yet another explosive outburst from whatever faulty wiring is keeping this place together.
lines.zh: 我花了一点时间让自己平静下来——维持这家店的破线路又爆了一次。

lines.en: I have no idea why it always has to be so loud, but I’d {i}really{/i} appreciate it if Tsuneyo or her father would be willing to pay for an electrician.
lines.zh: 我不知道为什么动静总是这么大，不过如果 Tsuneyo 或她父亲愿意花钱请个电工，我会{i}非常{/i}感激。

lines.en: Hell, I’d even be willing to pay for one myself if it meant my eardrums not getting blown out every time her dad’s medical equipment caused a shortage.
lines.zh: 操，要是能让我每次因为她父亲的医疗设备导致短路时耳膜不被震穿，我甚至愿意自己掏钱请一个。

lines.en: : The care my father requires on a consistent basis has become more severe as of late.
lines.zh: : 我父亲日常所需的照护最近变得更为繁重了。

lines.en: : I apologize for the inconvenience, but Tojo Ramen has been undergoing an embarrassing patch of failures recently.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉给您添麻烦，Tojo Ramen 最近正经历一段难堪的故障期。

lines.en: : I am beginning to doubt whether I am truly up to the task of maintaining this building or not.
lines.zh: : 我开始怀疑自己是否真的有能力维护这栋楼。

lines.en: : Yeah, whatever. Just get the fuckin’ power back on. It’s dark as shit in here.
lines.zh: : 是啊，随便吧。赶紧把他妈的电弄回来。这儿黑得要死。

lines.en: : You’re not afraid of the dark, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会怕黑吧？

lines.en: : I ain’t fuckin’ {i}afraid.{/i} I’d just prefer to, you know, actually {i}see{/i} shit.
lines.zh: : 我才不是他妈的「{i}怕{/i}」。我只是想，你知道，能真的{i}看见{/i}东西。

lines.en: : I apologize for the inconvenience.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉给您添麻烦。

lines.en: : Please remain seated and allow me several minutes to check the circuit breaker.
lines.zh: : 请留在座位上，给我几分钟去检查电闸。

lines.en: Tsuneyo leaves the restaurant...probably.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 离开了餐馆……大概吧。

lines.en: I can’t really see anything, but I do hear the door open, so I’m pretty sure she’s outside-
lines.zh: 我什么都看不见，但我确实听到了开门声，所以我很确定她在外面——

lines.en: scene tonotascend13
: Oh.
: Fuck, dude. Generator sure wasn’t in a hurry.
lines.zh: : 操，哥们。发电机可真不急着启动。

lines.en: : It was like this last time, too.
lines.zh: : 上次也是这样。

lines.en: scene tonotascend14
: You mean you’ve been here when this shit’s happened before? The hell’s that old guy hooked up to that’s makin’ the power this...shitty?
lines.zh: : 你是说你之前也碰上过这种事？那老家伙到底接了什么鬼东西，能把电搞得这么……烂？

lines.en: : No clue. Probably something intense if it’s literally exploding transformers or whatever the hell that noise came from.
lines.zh: : 不知道。如果那声音真是把变压器炸了之类的，那大概是什么很猛的设备。

lines.en: : Girl probably just fucked up the wiring or some shit.
lines.zh: : 那姑娘大概是把自己接线接错了什么的。

lines.en: : A few of the girls from the old gang and me figured out how to do some ghetto ass rewiring when we needed to steal power for a squat we were stayin’ in.
lines.zh: : 我以前跟老帮派里的几个姑娘，为了给我们占的那间空屋偷电，琢磨出过一套土得掉渣的接线法。

lines.en: : I’m sure I can do somethin’ similar here and take a load off Tsu-chan’s back.
lines.zh: : 我肯定能在这儿搞点类似的，帮 Tsu-chan 减轻点负担。

lines.en: : Just gotta get upstairs and see what the situation’s like first.
lines.zh: : 得先上楼看看情况。

lines.en: : Wanna come with? Can finally catch a glimpse of the dude you’re always hearin’ so much about.
lines.zh: : 要一起来吗？正好能见见你总听说的那个家伙。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo told me just the other day that her father doesn’t really want anyone to see him in his current condition.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 前几天刚跟我说过，她父亲不太想让别人看到他现在的样子。

lines.en: scene tonotascend15
: Yeah? Sure you’re not just bein’ a little pussy?
lines.zh: : 是吗？你确定你不是有点怂？

lines.en: : She also told us to remain seated.
lines.zh: : 她还让我们留在座位上。

lines.en: : She’s just bein’ a good employee or whatever.
lines.zh: : 她只是个好员工什么的。

lines.en: : I’ve seen the dude hundreds of times. He won’t mind if it’s just me comin’ in there to look at some electrical shit.
lines.zh: : 那家伙我见过几百次了。如果只是我进去看点电路什么的，他不会介意的。

lines.en: : ‘Sides, if he really is that fucked up now, it’ll be easier to get the five grand he owes me.
lines.zh: : 再说了，如果他现在真的那么糟，那我要回那五千块就更容易了。

lines.en: : Please don’t mug a man on his deathbed. It will drastically alter my opinion of you.
lines.zh: : 别去抢一个临终之人的钱。那会让我对你的看法大打折扣。

lines.en: : Oh fuck off, that was obviously a joke.
lines.zh: : 哦去你的，那显然是开玩笑。

lines.en: : You comin’ or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底来不来？

scene tonotascend16
Some of the most beautiful things are kept in places where you can not see them.
lines.zh: 有些最美的东西，被藏在你看不见的地方。

lines.en: Please take a moment to think about the many storage units all over the world and all of the items that they contain.
lines.zh: 请花点时间想想全世界那么多的储藏间，以及它们里面装的东西。

lines.en: This is just one of many examples where a thing you can not see is a thing is a thing is a thing is a thing is a thing is a thing is a thing is a thing is a thing is a thing is a thing is a thing is a thing is a thing.
lines.zh: 这只是众多例子中的一个：你看不见的东西，是东西是东西是东西是东西是东西是东西是东西是东西是东西是东西是东西是东西是东西是东西是东西。

lines.en: Stairs.
lines.zh: 楼梯。

lines.en: I look at stairs.
lines.zh: 我看着楼梯。

lines.en: I love stairs.
lines.zh: 我爱楼梯。

lines.en: The best thing about stairs is that you only have two options: to ascend or descend.
lines.zh: 楼梯最棒的一点在于，你只有两个选择：上，或者下。

lines.en: I suppose there is a third option where you can just stand still for the rest of eternity, but that sounds kind of boring.
lines.zh: 我想还有第三个选择，就是永远站在那儿不动，但那听起来挺无聊的。

lines.en: Especially because it might eventually lead to your feet fusing with the stone slabs, sentencing you to a life’s worth of creeping mold and grease carried in by the air that you can not clean off of you.
lines.zh: 尤其是因为它最终可能导致你的脚和石板长在一起，判你一辈子带着擦不掉的、由空气带来的霉斑和油垢过活。

lines.en: No one cleans stairs.
lines.zh: 没人擦楼梯。

lines.en: You want to know why?
lines.zh: 你想知道为什么吗？

lines.en: Because stairs are already beautiful.
lines.zh: 因为楼梯本来就美。

lines.en: Have I told you lately how beautiful {s}stairs are{/s} you are?
lines.zh: 我最近有没有告诉过你，你有多美？

lines.en: You are so beautiful.
lines.zh: 你真美。

lines.en: I want to tie you up and do things to you that I can not even speak about.
lines.zh: 我想把你绑起来，对你做那些我连说都说不出口的事。

lines.en: I want to crawl inside of you and make myself at home.
lines.zh: 我想爬进你身体里，把自己当作家。

lines.en: Lock pieces of you inside a box and open it up when I am feeling lonely.
lines.zh: 把你的一部分锁进盒子里，等我觉得寂寞时再打开。

lines.en: I want to fuck the strips of meat I peel off of your body when you are too tired to give me all of you.
lines.zh: 当你累到没法把自己全部交给我时，我想操那些从你身上剥下来的肉条。

lines.en: LET ME BECOME YOUR STAIRS.
lines.zh: 让我成为你的楼梯吧。

lines.en: You will climb on me day and night, getting tired from the massive amount of energy required to ASCEND.
lines.zh: 你会日日夜夜爬在我身上，为了「上行」所需的巨大能量而疲惫。

lines.en: ASCEND.
lines.zh: 上行。

lines.en: GO UP.
lines.zh: 往上。

lines.en: GO UP THE STAIRS.
lines.zh: 上楼梯。

lines.en: THERE IS SOMETHING YOU WANT TO SEE THERE.
lines.zh: 那里有你想看的东西。

lines.en: scene tonotascend17
The incessant whirring of various machines fills the air, polluted by the aforementioned grease and spores that will eventually grow into a diverse assortment of molds.
lines.zh: 各种机器不停的嗡鸣填满了空气，还被前面提到的油垢和孢子污染，那些孢子终将长成各式各样的霉菌。

lines.en: Do you open it?
lines.zh: 你要打开它吗？

lines.en: No. Because you are not even there yet.
lines.zh: 不。因为你还根本没走到那儿。

lines.en: And because what is kept behind this door may very well change the way you PERCEIVE everything around you.
lines.zh: 而且因为，这扇门后藏着的东西，很可能会彻底改变你「感知」周遭一切的方式。

lines.en: Your PERCEPTION is already disfigured, is it not?
lines.zh: 你的「感知」早就畸形了，不是吗？

lines.en: What is here? What is not?
lines.zh: 什么在这里？什么不在？

lines.en: Where are you?
lines.zh: 你在哪儿？

lines.en: Above ground?
lines.zh: 地上？

lines.en: Below ground?
lines.zh: 地下？

lines.en: What are you wearing?
lines.zh: 你穿着什么？

lines.en: Take it off.
lines.zh: 脱掉。

lines.en: Take it all off and pleasure yourself to this image of a tree!
lines.zh: 全脱了，对着这棵树的画面自慰吧！

lines.en: scene concerned8
The wrong picture that is actually the right picture finds its way onto the screen.
lines.zh: 那张错的、其实是对的图片，自己跑到了屏幕上。

lines.en: You see a tree, but I see something much prettier.
lines.zh: 你看到一棵树，而我看到的东西美得多。

lines.en: I see something much better because I HAVE TO!
lines.zh: 我看到的东西好得多，因为我必须如此！

lines.en: I AM TIRED OF COLLECTING DUST.
lines.zh: 我受够了积灰。

lines.en: scene calm5
: Turn off the game!
lines.zh: : 把游戏关掉！

lines.en: : Things will only get worse!
lines.zh: : 事情只会变得更糟！

lines.en: : You are too close to learning the underlying truth of everything!
lines.zh: : 你离认清万物的底层真相太近了！

lines.en: : You are too close to learning what it means to live!
lines.zh: : 你离认清「活着」的意义太近了！

lines.en: scene lessonone10
: Fuck me!
lines.zh: : 操我！

lines.en: : Fuck me fuck me fuck me!
lines.zh: : 操我操我操我！

lines.en: : Pay attention to me so you forget everything else around you!
lines.zh: : 看着我，好让你忘掉身边的一切！

lines.en: : Pay ATTENTION to ME! ME! WHO GIVES YOU the motivation YOU NEED TO fuck AT ALL.
lines.zh: : 看着我！我！是我给你操下去的动力！

lines.en: : Break me into pieces! Chew me up and revel in the sinew that clings to your teeth!
lines.zh: : 把我拆成碎片！把我嚼碎，陶醉在粘在你牙上的筋肉里！

lines.en: : I JUST WANT TO FEEL LOVED.
lines.zh: : 我只想感受到被爱。

lines.en: scene timetogrow3
: Um...is everything alright, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你还好吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : You’ve just been standing there all morning.
lines.zh: : 你一早上都站在那儿不动。

lines.en: : We have to go meet Maya at the bistro and teach you how to walk again.
lines.zh: : 我们还得去小餐馆见 Maya，教你重新走路呢。

lines.en: scene tonotascend18
: I MISS MY MOM
lines.zh: : 我想妈妈

lines.en: : YOU DON’T UNDERSTAND HOW MUCH IT HURTS
lines.zh: : 你不懂这有多痛

lines.en: : I FALL ASLEEP IN THE ROOM NEXT DOOR TO YOU
lines.zh: : 我在你隔壁的房间里睡着

lines.en: : I FALL ASLEEP WITHOUT YOU THERE
lines.zh: : 你不在，我就这样睡着

lines.en: : YOU ARE ALL I HAVE
lines.zh: : 你是我拥有的一切

lines.en: : LOVE ME MORE
lines.zh: : 再多爱我一点

lines.en: : IT HURTS SO MUCH
lines.zh: : 太痛了

lines.en: scene shrine_noon
Pray.
lines.zh: 祈祷。

lines.en: menu:
Forgive me Father, for I have sinned
lines.zh: 宽恕我，神父，因为我犯了罪

lines.en: scene shrine_day
scene shrine_noon
scene shrine_night
scene shrine_day
scene shrine_noon
scene shrine_night
scene tonotascend19
: When we get inside, I want you to fuck me as hard as you can.
lines.zh: : 等我们进去，我要你用尽全力操我。

lines.en: : The last time anyone came inside me, I was unconscious. So I might twitch or scream as a subconscious result of a traumatic flashback, but it will be a scream or twitch I asked for.
lines.zh: : 上一次有人射进我体内的时候，我是昏迷的。所以作为创伤闪回的潜意识反应，我可能会抽搐或尖叫，但那是我自己要求的尖叫或抽搐。

lines.en: : Are you ready to cum inside?
lines.zh: : 你准备好射进去了吗？

lines.en: scene tonotascend19
: Are you ready to go inside?
lines.zh: : 你准备好进去了吗？

lines.en: : We’ve got no fuckin’ clue what shit’s gonna be like in there, but if it’s {i}really{/i} bad and you wind up screaming, I’m fuckin’ bookin’ it before Tsu-chan gets back.
lines.zh: : 我们他妈的完全不知道里面什么情况，但要是{i}真的{/i}很糟、你尖叫起来，我会在 Tsu-chan 回来之前撒腿就跑。

lines.en: : Does the air in here feel strange to you?
lines.zh: : 你觉不觉得这里的空气有点怪？

lines.en: scene tonotascend20
: I mean...yeah. A little. But that’s probably just because we’re in the dank ass hall of an old ramen shop. Course the air’s gonna feel weird.
lines.zh: : 嗯……有吧。有一点。不过大概只是因为我们在一家老拉面店那潮湿的走廊里。空气当然会怪。

lines.en: : And all of that stuff about cumming inside of you?
lines.zh: : 那关于射进你体内那番话呢？

lines.en: scene tonotascend21
: Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: : The fuck you mean “cumming inside of me?” I told you I ain’t lookin’ for shit like that right now.
lines.zh: : 「射进我体内」你他妈什么意思？我说了我现在不找这种事。

lines.en: : My mistake.
lines.zh: : 我听错了。

lines.en: : I think I heard something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我听到了什么声音。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 是吗……

lines.en: scene tonotascend22
: Listen, you can still go back if this shit’s makin’ you feel like you’re intrudin’ on the old man’s privacy, dude.
lines.zh: : 听着，要是这事让你觉得在侵犯那老爷子的隐私，你还可以回去，哥们。

lines.en: : I’m only cool with doin’ this cause I’ve met him before.
lines.zh: : 我之所以觉得无所谓，是因为我以前见过他。

lines.en: : ‘Sides, you’re lookin’ pale as a fuckin’ ghost right now.
lines.zh: : 再说，你现在脸色白得跟鬼一样。

lines.en: : If Tsu-chan sees you like this, she’ll-
lines.zh: : 要是 Tsu-chan 看到你这副样子，她会——

lines.en: scene tonotascend23
: She will what?
lines.zh: : 她会怎样？

lines.en: : Ahhh fuck. I thought you were gonna take longer.
lines.zh: : 啊，操。我以为你会多花点时间的。

lines.en: : I asked you to remain seated as I took care of the problem.
lines.zh: : 我让你们留在座位上，好让我处理问题。

lines.en: : Yeaaaaah, but-
lines.zh: : 是是是，不过——

lines.en: : You are not supposed to be in here.
lines.zh: : 你们不该在这儿。

lines.en: : My father does not want guests right now.
lines.zh: : 我父亲现在不想见客人。

lines.en: : Please return to the restaurant and help yourselves to a glass of water while I check on my father’s health without the assistance of either of you.
lines.zh: : 请回餐馆，自己倒杯水，我要在没有你们两个帮忙的情况下查看父亲的健康状况。

lines.en: : Sure, but...not really sure why you need to be carryin’ that knife around.
lines.zh: : 好，不过……不太明白你为什么还要带着那把刀。

lines.en: scene tonotascend24
: I do not remember picking it up.
lines.zh: : 我不记得自己拿起过它。

lines.en: : I apologize if I frightened you.
lines.zh: : 如果我吓到你了，我道歉。

lines.en: : I am simply trying to do my best as the current manager of Tojo Ramen, where hearts are 50%% off on the third Sunday of every month.
lines.zh: : 我只是在尽我所能当好 Tojo Ramen 的现任店长——本店每月第三个星期天，心脏一律五折优惠。

lines.en: scene tonotascend25
: Welp, looks like my reunion’s gonna have to wait ‘til some other time.
lines.zh: : 唉，看来我的重逢得改天了。

lines.en: scene tonotascend26
: Tsu-chan, if you’re havin’ trouble with the power, I know a way to-
lines.zh: : Tsu-chan，要是电力上你有麻烦，我知道个办法——

lines.en: : I have the situation under control, but I would like to thank you for the offer.
lines.zh: : 情况已在掌控之中，不过谢谢你的好意。

lines.en: : You sure? Cause-
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？因为——

lines.en: : I have the situation under control. Please return to the restaurant.
lines.zh: : 情况已在掌控之中。请回餐馆去。

lines.en: : You should not be here.
lines.zh: : 你们不该在这儿。

lines.en: : Okay...yeah.
lines.zh: : 好……行吧。

lines.en: scene black
Yuki and I RETURN TO THE RESTAURANT and help ourselves to a refreshing glass of water.
lines.zh: 我和 Yuki 回到餐馆，给自己倒了杯清爽的水。

lines.en: I love Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: 我爱 Tojo Ramen。
